subject: Deploy Doré Design 1.4 same-workspace preview
body: Pull merged PR #263 and restart Doré Design on localhost:4310. Verify /editor and / use the same structured workspace and same renderer. Check /api/health reports version 1.4 and preview_mode same-workspace-same-renderer, then check /api/preview/status and return exact workspace id, revision, homepage node count, and HTTP evidence. Preserve Journal/Vol.00 mirrors and current workspace data.
